title: KCP artifact_upload_begin request (DESIGN.md §10.10, §11.6.1 space/content mutation family)
description: Mutation (meta required; §11.2: every state-changing operation requires meta). Atomically creates the pending artifact/upload, idempotency result, event, and outbox row (§10.10 spelled). Args are the declared_* fields of the §10.10 ArtifactUpload (gap note KG29); max_bytes comes from realm policy and the staging key is server-selected. The canonical result contains only the durable upload/artifact refs and constraints; replay returns that same result and never mints a credential (§10.10 spelled). Registry (shared_space_v1): surface external_client / principal; mapped connector (only for contribution/reaction/upload operations granted to it) (assurance: current login (principal); workload identity (mapped connector)). Surface and actor kind are registry-enforced, not schema-expressible (gap note KG14 for dual-surface ops).

classification_ref.description: Optional: defaults from realm policy when omitted (gap note KG29).

args.description: Caller-declared upload facts (§10.10 record shape, names verbatim; gap note KG29); declarations are not verification — the artifact service verifies trusted bytes after sealing (§10.10).

commandMeta.description: Command.meta (§11.2). Required on every mutation; idempotency keys are scoped by authenticated actor, operation, and realm; expected_revision drives optimistic concurrency (mismatch is stale-revision).

ext.description: Extensions keyed by a reverse-domain namespace (§11.9); never interpreted as identity, authorization, budget, or policy.

identifier.description: Opaque identifier, at most 128 bytes (§11.8); visible-ASCII alphabet is a K0 extraction decision (spec/schemas/README.md).

mediaType.description: RFC 6838 type/subtype token pair (media_type/declared_media_type); parameters are not carried in these fields — recorded extraction bound (gap note KG21/KG29).

protocolVersion.description: Negotiated KCP major.minor version; the initial protocol version is "0.1" (§11).

rawSha256.description: Ordinary raw SHA-256 content checksum (raw_sha256/declared_raw_sha256, §10.10) for integrity and content-addressing; a different field type from the §11.8 typed digests, never interchangeable with them even when the 32-byte values match (§11.8).

safeNonNegativeInteger.description: I-JSON safe integer (§11.8 rejects unsafe integers).

traceparent.description: W3C Trace Context traceparent header value; excluded from the idempotency request digest (§11.2).
